Joining the ongoing early fall Prime Day sale at Amazon and the ongoing all-time low on the single AirTag 2 listing, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the most affordable 2026 Studio Display models at up to $300 off straight from Apple refurb. And while this M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $500 off might be the best early fall Prime Day deal yet, the Belkin holiday deals are now live from $13 with its latest 25W MagSafe chargers now at new all-time lows, alongside the official Eve fall Prime Day deals at up to 38% off – Matter/HomeKit switches, plugs, outlets, and more from $30. We also have an extra 10% off already discounted official Apple USB-C, Thunderbolt, and MagSafe cables today from $7.50 each. Head below for a closer look.

You can still score a single 2026 Apple AirTag 2 down at Amazon all-time low pricing

We have caught a number of notable deals on the 4-pack, but for folks who just don’t need four of We have caught a number of notable deals on the 4-pack, but for folks who just don’t need four of them, Amazon’s early fall Prime Day sale is still offering Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 down at its lowest price to date in brand new condition.

While we aren’t talking about a giant discount here at $24 Prime shipped, keep in mind this is a 2026 Apple release that was already only $29.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low

You can still score a discount on the 4-pack at $89 – that’s $22.50 apiece, but we have seen it down $9 lower more than a few times now over the last couple months, and we might very well again in the coming week for fall Prime Day.

This is also suggests we might see the single down lower as well, but how much lower could it possibly get?

Sure, catching this thing down at $20 Prime shipped would certainly be notable, and even possible at this point, but there’s no way to know for sure and that’s only $4 less than it is right now. If past AirTag discounts in the $20 or under range during major sale events are any indication, it might be harder to actually get than it seems unless you are waiting at the ready when it happens.

It is very much possible we see the single listing down a touch lower between now and fall Prime Day’s end in the early hours of the morning on Oct 8 (ET), but it’s not likely to sell for much less than this.

Most affordable 2026 Studio Display models are up to $300 off straight from Apple refurb today

Alongside the ongoing early fall Prime Day sale at Amazon, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is delivering some notable offers on the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display – the Tilt-adjustable stand is $240 off and the Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand is $300 off.

The official Apple refurb store is now once again offering the 2026 Apple Studio Display with the Tilt-adjustable stand down at $1,359 shipped. This one carries a $1,599 list price and is now $240 off the list price – it is currently selling for $1,550 at Amazon where it has never dropped below $1,484.

And you’ll find the 2026 model Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand down at $1,699 shipped. This is a $1,999 display that is now a solid $300 off the list and well below the $1,984 Amazon is asking for right now – this one has never sold for less than $1,886 in new condition at Amazon.

Here are some details on Apple refurb store listings:

  • Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale
  • Covered by Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare product can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrap not available for refurbished products
  • Supplies are limited

This M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $500 off might be the best early fall Prime Day deal yet

The early Amazon fall Prime Day sale is flying with thousands of price drops, but there is one particularly notable Apple deal we want to highlight before it disappears. There’s no telling how things might go with the latest MacBook Pro lineup for Prime Day next week, but you can already score a giant $500 off this M5 Pro 2TB model.

Now available in both the Space Black and Silver colorways, Amazon is offering the 14-inch MN5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM, the 2TB storage capacity, and the upgraded 18/20-Core internals down at $2,699 shipped.

That’s still quite an investment, but we are talking about Apple’s M5 Pro chip here and one supported by the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU with notable 2TB of storage at the ready here. It is also sitting at the same price as the less powerful 15/16-Core model

We are also talking about a machine that carries a $3,199 list price now, and one you can currently land at $500 less than this.

Extra 10% off already discounted official Apple USB-C, Thunderbolt, and MagSafe cables today from $7.50 each

Still live: New Beats 360 ANC headphones launch deal – 80% off modular Cushion Kits at $10

Just a quick head sup here: Yesterday Amazon had countdown clocks on the new Beats 360 ANC Headphones launch deal, but it has apparently decided to keep the 80% price drop on the modular Cushion Kits rolling through today.

As we detailed previously, the new Beats 360 feature a modular system that allows users to flip out the ear cushions and headband pad to customize the look and feel of the new headphones – there are Performance Knit styles and a pair of UltraPlush options:

  • Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (Reg. $50)

The headphones are launching at full price, but the Cushion Kits are still sitting at 80% off via Amazon right now. It appears as though this deal was ending yesterday, but it is still flying as of this morning.

Don’t pay full price for Pitaka’s aramid fiber iPhone Duo Case, it’s half the price at Amazon today

The release of Apple’s exciting new iPhone Duo is quickly approaching and the accessories to elevate your experience are landing as well. Arguably, the USB-C Apple Pencil is going to be one of the most useful and powerful Duo accessories for some folks, but we are also tracking a early deal on Pitaka’s iPhone Duo Edge Case – this thing carries a $100 MSRP and is now sitting down at $49.99 shipped on Amazon.

While the aerospace-grade aramid fiber Pitaka iPhone Duo Edge Case has never fetched $100 at Amazon, it certainly does on the official site and you can now secure one in your different colors down at $50. They first landed on Amazon at $60, so this is technically more like $17 off, but you certainly don’t want to get “tricked” into buying one for $100:

  • Pitaka iPhone Duo Edge Case $50 (Reg. $60 at Amazon, $100 MSRP)

Just after launching some early fall Prime Day deals, Twelve South is ready to launch its all-new Airfly Drive today. The latest entry in the Airfly lineup, the new CarPlay and Android Auto adapter is live and available for purchase at $39.99. There’s a ton of no name brands out there making something similar (and usually much less elegant than this), but Twelve South has arrived.

More details right here.
